selection.choose_when: Use the Brands Opening DM component when a button interaction precedes the link.
selection.avoid_when: Do not assume the Brands campaign integration exists in Chatfuel.

safety.delivery_limit: No Set Live or send action. Scoped 0 runs before trigger removal and n/a list metrics are not account-wide no-delivery proof.

gaps: Original server settings and IDs were not exported. Clone defaults are not asserted to equal source defaults.
Runtime was not tested because execution is forbidden; this is separate from settings completeness.
All existing node defaults were opened. Shared options are evidence-matched; exhaustive alternative node-type conversion is not proven.
